items.quote: Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
items.claim: Abraham was told that Milcah had borne children to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
items.mechanism: report delivered to Abraham ('it was told Abraham')

items.quote: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram, 22:22 And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
items.claim: The text names eight sons of Nahor and Milcah: Huz (the firstborn), Buz, Kemuel, Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph and Bethuel.
items.object: Huz, Buz, Kemuel, Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, Bethuel

items.claim: Kemuel, a son of Nahor, is called the father of Aram.
